Title: Release of Service Fabric SDK 2.5.216 and Runtime 5.5.216 for Windows

Body.Content:
Version 2.5.216 of the Azure Service Fabric SDK is now available, along with the 5.5.216 runtime that rolled out to Azure clusters worldwide.

This release contains new features and lots of other improvements. Read more about this release on the Azure blog, or go straight to the detailed release notes.
